```{r}
# ================================================================
# Corn NNI: Elastic Net band selection + SVM, RF, XGBoost
# Fully nested preprocessing / feature selection / grid tuning
# Outer LOOCV, inner 5-fold CV, grouped by 'group'
# Output: ./output_2/
# ================================================================

required <- c('readr','dplyr','tidyr','purrr','ggplot2',
              'recipes','parsnip','glmnet','rsample','kernlab','ranger','xgboost')
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly=TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop('Install packages: install.packages(c(',
                          paste(sprintf('"%s"', missing), collapse=', '), '))')

SEED <- 123L
set.seed(SEED)
INPUT_FILE <- './output/df_clean_names.csv'
OUTPUT_DIR <- './output_3'
TARGET <- 'r6_nni_combined'
GROUPS <- c('V8','R1-R2','R5-R6')
MAX_BANDS <- 5L
INNER_V <- 5L
RF_TREES <- 300L
# For initial debugging: change to c('V8') and then restore GROUPS.
GROUPS_TO_RUN <- GROUPS

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
if (!file.exists(INPUT_FILE)) stop('Input not found: ', INPUT_FILE)
df <- readr::read_csv(INPUT_FILE, show_col_types=FALSE)
bands <- grep('^band_[0-9]+$', names(df), value=TRUE)
stopifnot('group' %in% names(df), TARGET %in% names(df), length(bands)>0L)
if (!all(vapply(df[bands], is.numeric, logical(1)))) stop('Bands must be numeric')

# ------------------------------------------------
# Metrics (prediction R2 can be negative)
# ------------------------------------------------
metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  if (length(obs)<2L || length(obs)!=length(pred) || any(!is.finite(c(obs,pred))))
    stop('Invalid observed or predicted values')
  e <- pred-obs
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(e^2)); sst <- sum((obs-mean(obs))^2)
  data.frame(R2=if (sst>0) 1-sum(e^2)/sst else NA_real_,
             RMSE=rmse, MAE=mean(abs(e)), Bias=mean(e),
             RPD=if (rmse>0) stats::sd(obs)/rmse else NA_real_,
             RPIQ=if (rmse>0) stats::IQR(obs)/rmse else NA_real_,
             nRMSE=if (abs(mean(obs))>0) 100*rmse/abs(mean(obs)) else NA_real_)
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# Elastic Net: training data ONLY; select up to 5 bands
# ------------------------------------------------
select_bands <- function(train, seed, k=MAX_BANDS) {
  x <- as.matrix(train[, bands, drop=FALSE]); y <- train[[TARGET]]
  s <- apply(x, 2L, stats::sd)
  keep <- names(s)[is.finite(s) & s > 1e-10]
  if (!length(keep)) stop('No varying predictors in training partition')
  x <- x[, keep, drop=FALSE]
  set.seed(seed)
  cv <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha=0.5, nfolds=5L,
                          standardize=TRUE, type.measure='mse')
  get_coef <- function(lambda) {
    z <- as.matrix(stats::coef(cv, s=lambda))
    a <- as.numeric(z[-1L,1L]); names(a) <- rownames(z)[-1L]
    a[is.finite(a) & abs(a)>1e-10]
  }
  b <- get_coef('lambda.1se')
  if (!length(b)) b <- get_coef('lambda.min')
  if (!length(b)) {
    cc <- apply(x,2L,function(z) abs(stats::cor(z,y)))
    return(names(which.max(cc)))
  }
  head(names(sort(abs(b), decreasing=TRUE)), k)
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# recipes preprocessing from training set ONLY
# - SVM: zero-variance filter, then Z-score normalize
# - RF/XGBoost: zero-variance filter, no scaling needed
# ------------------------------------------------
prepare_data <- function(train, other, selected, model) {
  tr <- data.frame(NNI=train[[TARGET]], train[,selected,drop=FALSE], check.names=FALSE)
  te <- data.frame(NNI=other[[TARGET]], other[,selected,drop=FALSE], check.names=FALSE)
  rec <- recipes::recipe(NNI ~ ., data=tr) |>
    recipes::step_zv(recipes::all_predictors())
  if (model=='SVM') {
    rec <- rec |> recipes::step_normalize(recipes::all_predictors())
  }
  baked <- recipes::prep(rec, training=tr, retain=TRUE)
  tr2 <- recipes::bake(baked, new_data=tr)
  te2 <- recipes::bake(baked, new_data=te)
  vars <- setdiff(names(tr2),'NNI')
  if (!length(vars)) stop('All selected predictors eliminated by preprocessing')
  list(xtr=tr2[,vars,drop=FALSE], ytr=tr2$NNI,
       xte=te2[,vars,drop=FALSE], vars=vars)
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# Candidate grids; compact for small sample sizes
# ------------------------------------------------
grid_for <- function(model, p) {
  if (model=='SVM')
    return(expand.grid(cost=c(0.5,2,8), rbf_sigma=c(0.01,0.1),
                       KEEP.OUT.ATTRS=FALSE))
  if (model=='Random_Forest')
    return(expand.grid(mtry=unique(pmax(1L,pmin(p,c(1L, floor(sqrt(p)),p)))),
                       min_n=c(3L,5L),KEEP.OUT.ATTRS=FALSE))
  if (model=='XGBoost')
    return(expand.grid(trees=c(50L,100L),tree_depth=c(1L,2L),
                       learn_rate=c(0.05,0.1),KEEP.OUT.ATTRS=FALSE))
  stop('Unknown model')
}

make_spec <- function(model, pars, p) {
  if (model=='SVM')
    return(parsnip::svm_rbf(mode='regression', cost=pars$cost,
                            rbf_sigma=pars$rbf_sigma, margin=0.1) |>
             parsnip::set_engine('kernlab'))
  if (model=='Random_Forest')
    return(parsnip::rand_forest(mode='regression', mtry=min(as.integer(pars$mtry),p),
                                min_n=as.integer(pars$min_n), trees=RF_TREES) |>
             parsnip::set_engine('ranger', num.threads=1L, seed=SEED))
  if (model=='XGBoost')
    return(parsnip::boost_tree(mode='regression',
                     trees=as.integer(pars$trees),
                     tree_depth=as.integer(pars$tree_depth),
                     learn_rate=pars$learn_rate, min_n=2L,
                     mtry=p, loss_reduction=0,
                     sample_size=0.8) |>
             parsnip::set_engine('xgboost', nthread=1L, verbose=0))
  stop('Unknown model')
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# Fit a candidate and predict using fresh recipe
# ------------------------------------------------
fit_predict <- function(train, test, selected, model, pars, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  pr <- prepare_data(train, test, selected, model)
  spec <- make_spec(model, pars, ncol(pr$xtr))
  fit <- parsnip::fit_xy(spec, x=pr$xtr, y=pr$ytr)
  ptr <- as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, new_data=pr$xtr)$.pred)
  pte <- as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, new_data=pr$xte)$.pred)
  if (any(!is.finite(c(ptr,pte)))) stop('Nonfinite predictions')
  list(train=ptr, test=pte, actual_train=pr$ytr, fit=fit)
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# Inner CV: reselect bands on EACH inner training fold
# ------------------------------------------------
tune_model <- function(outer_train, model, outer_seed) {
  set.seed(outer_seed)
  folds <- rsample::vfold_cv(outer_train, v=INNER_V)
  # Precompute selected bands once per inner fold, not per candidate.
  inner <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(folds)), function(j) {
    a <- rsample::analysis(folds$splits[[j]])
    b <- rsample::assessment(folds$splits[[j]])
    sel <- select_bands(a, seed=outer_seed+100L+j)
    list(train=a, test=b, selected=sel)
  })
  # Tune on a consistent grid across inner folds; RF mtry bounded per fit.
  min_p <- min(vapply(inner, function(z) length(z$selected), integer(1)))
  grid <- grid_for(model, min_p)
  scores <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(grid))
  for (g in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
    errors <- numeric(0)
    for (j in seq_along(inner)) {
      z <- inner[[j]]
      fp <- fit_predict(z$train,z$test,z$selected,model,grid[g,,drop=FALSE],
                        seed=outer_seed+10000L+g*100L+j)
      errors <- c(errors,fp$test-z$test[[TARGET]])
    }
    scores[g] <- sqrt(mean(errors^2))
  }
  winning <- which.min(scores)
  list(best=grid[winning,,drop=FALSE], tuning_rmse=scores[winning],
       grid=cbind(grid, inner_RMSE=scores))
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# Run outer LOOCV separately for each development group
# ------------------------------------------------
run_group <- function(gr, group_index) {
  d <- df[df$group==gr,,drop=FALSE]
  d <- d[stats::complete.cases(d[,c(TARGET,bands),drop=FALSE]),,drop=FALSE]
  rownames(d) <- NULL
  if (nrow(d)<12L) stop('Not enough observations in group: ',gr)
  pred <- list(); train_scores <- list(); chosen <- list(); tunes <- list()
  models <- c('SVM','Random_Forest','XGBoost')
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    outer_seed <- SEED+100000L*group_index+i
    train <- d[-i,,drop=FALSE]
    test <- d[i,,drop=FALSE]
    # Outer feature selection uses outer training set ONLY.
    outer_bands <- select_bands(train, seed=outer_seed)
    chosen[[i]] <- data.frame(group=gr, fold=i, band=outer_bands,
                              rank=seq_along(outer_bands))
    for (m in models) {
      # Full nested inner evaluation: independent band selection per inner fold.
      tuned <- tune_model(train,m,outer_seed)
      final <- fit_predict(train,test,outer_bands,m,tuned$best,
                           seed=outer_seed+50000L)
      pred[[length(pred)+1L]] <- data.frame(
        group=gr,fold=i,model=m,observed=test[[TARGET]],
        predicted=final$test,n_bands=length(outer_bands))
      train_scores[[length(train_scores)+1L]] <- data.frame(
        group=gr,fold=i,model=m,n_bands=length(outer_bands),
        metrics(final$actual_train,final$train))
      best_values <- unlist(tuned$best,use.names=TRUE)
      tunes[[length(tunes)+1L]] <- data.frame(
        group=gr,fold=i,model=m,parameter=c(names(best_values),'inner_RMSE'),
        value=as.character(c(unname(best_values),tuned$tuning_rmse)))
    }
    if (i %% 10L == 0L || i == nrow(d))
      message(gr,' - ',i,'/',nrow(d),' outer folds complete')
  }
  list(predictions=dplyr::bind_rows(pred),
       train_metrics=dplyr::bind_rows(train_scores),
       bands=dplyr::bind_rows(chosen),
       tuning=dplyr::bind_rows(tunes))
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# Execute, saving each completed group
# ------------------------------------------------
results <- vector('list',length(GROUPS_TO_RUN))
names(results) <- GROUPS_TO_RUN
for (j in seq_along(GROUPS_TO_RUN)) {
  gr <- GROUPS_TO_RUN[j]
  message('Starting group: ',gr)
  results[[j]] <- run_group(gr,j)
  saveRDS(results[[j]], file.path(OUTPUT_DIR,
               paste0('group_',gsub('[^[:alnum:]]+','_',gr),'.rds')))
}

predictions_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`,'predictions'))
training_folds <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`,'train_metrics'))
selected_bands_cv <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`,'bands'))
tuning_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`,'tuning'))

test_metrics <- predictions_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(group,model) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(~metrics(.x$observed,.x$predicted)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(dataset='Test')
train_metrics <- training_folds |>
  dplyr::group_by(group,model) |>
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(c(R2,RMSE,MAE,Bias,RPD,RPIQ,nRMSE),
                                 ~mean(.x,na.rm=TRUE)),.groups='drop') |>
  dplyr::mutate(dataset='Train')
model_performance <- dplyr::bind_rows(train_metrics,test_metrics) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=dataset,
                     values_from=c(R2,RMSE,MAE,Bias,RPD,RPIQ,nRMSE),
                     names_glue='{.value}_{dataset}') |>
  dplyr::arrange(group,RMSE_Test)

best_models <- model_performance |>
  dplyr::group_by(group) |>
  dplyr::slice_min(RMSE_Test,n=1,with_ties=FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

band_frequency <- selected_bands_cv |>
  dplyr::count(group,band,name='selected_n') |>
  dplyr::left_join(selected_bands_cv |>
      dplyr::distinct(group,fold) |>
      dplyr::count(group,name='n_folds'),by='group') |>
  dplyr::mutate(frequency_pct=100*selected_n/n_folds) |>
  dplyr::arrange(group,dplyr::desc(frequency_pct))

# All three algorithms use the Elastic Net-selected band set in each fold.
best_model_bands <- best_models |>
  dplyr::select(group,model,RMSE_Test,R2_Test) |>
  dplyr::left_join(band_frequency,by='group') |>
  dplyr::arrange(group,dplyr::desc(frequency_pct))

outputs <- list(
  NNI_LOOCV_predictions=predictions_long,
  NNI_training_fold_metrics=training_folds,
  NNI_selected_bands_CV=selected_bands_cv,
  NNI_grid_search_results=tuning_results,
  NNI_model_performance=model_performance,
  NNI_best_models=best_models,
  NNI_band_selection_frequency=band_frequency,
  NNI_best_model_bands=best_model_bands
)
for (nm in names(outputs))
  readr::write_csv(outputs[[nm]],file.path(OUTPUT_DIR,paste0(nm,'.csv')))

p1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(predictions_long,ggplot2::aes(observed,predicted)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha=.7,size=1.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept=0,slope=1,linetype='dashed',color='red') +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(group~model,scales='free') +
  ggplot2::labs(x='Observed NNI',y='LOOCV predicted NNI') +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR,'NNI_observed_vs_predicted.png'),
                p1,width=12,height=9,dpi=300)
p2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(model_performance,ggplot2::aes(model,RMSE_Test)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill='#31688e') +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~group,scales='free_y') +
  ggplot2::labs(x='Model',y='LOOCV RMSE') +
  ggplot2::theme_classic()
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR,'NNI_model_RMSE.png'),
                p2,width=10,height=5,dpi=300)

print(model_performance,n=Inf)
print(best_models,n=Inf)
message('Done. Outputs in ',normalizePath(OUTPUT_DIR))

```
